description:
Use when someone gives a watch reference number, such as 126610LN or 5711/1A, and wants to know which watch it is.
reference: the reference number as written.
Returns JSON: brand, model, case size, material, production years, the nickname buyers use when there is one, and Moda's reference page link when one exists. Moda publishes no prices.
name: look_up_watch_reference
title: Look up a watch reference
